pages.text: The pinnacle of dark magic and machinery. As the command hub of the stress network and stress series, the Stress Ark automatically collects data from all bound $(l:goetymech_machines/stress_reader)Stress Readers$(/l) and provides cross-dimensional stress computation for the $(l:goetymech_machines/remote_engine)Remote Engine$(/l) and all stress-series focuses.$(br)Can be broken by shift + right-click.$(br)$(4)"It is to stress magic what the Soul Ark is to soul magic — without it, long-range stress projection becomes exceedingly difficult."$()
